diagnostic_scope: FIXED 100-SAMPLE CV-BENCH SCREENING. This is a single-variable selection-constraint comparison at the layer-5 cut point and is explicitly NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion. No formal accuracy, promotion, acceleration or hardware claim may be derived from it.
round_scope: CPU-only preregistration, summariser and tests. No GPU run, no board run, no training, no hyper-parameter tuning, no dependency installation. The unbounded real-only arm raw JSONL is produced later by the host GPU runner exactly as pinned below; it did not exist when this file was written.
ablation_question: Holding the same screening100 manifest, layer-5 cut point, K=96, region_grid=3, BF16/SDPA/greedy decoding and the same frozen 3x3 anchor rule fixed, does replacing the bounded frozen hardware-regular selector (context pooling + context slot reservation + local_candidate_cap=16) with an unbounded real-only global-L2 + 3x3 anchor selection change the official CV-Bench screening100 accuracy by more than 0.02 (unbounded minus representative)?

single_variable_contract.baseline: frozen layer-5 raw-representative arm produced by evaluation/run_hf_hardware_regular_layer5_context_ablation.py (artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-layer5-context-pooling-ablation/layer5_context_ablation_k96_screening100.jsonl, SHA256 f09f5a539141d389d362af1fd2284fe4ab8cc5edc384c1a1904408ae491e796c)
identical: all output slots are raw real 2x2 groups
DeepStack index 5 called on the compact hidden
blocks 0..5 full then blocks 6..23 on the compact sequence
single_variable_contract.only_change: The bounded frozen hardware-regular selector (which reserves one context slot per 3x3 region, pools the remaining groups into SOURCE_CONTEXT slots and bounds detail candidates with local_candidate_cap=16) is replaced by an unbounded real-only selector: no context pooling, no context slot reservation, no local_candidate_cap; the K - anchors detail slots are taken from the global L2 ranking over all non-anchor groups.
single_variable_contract.verification: The unbounded runner records selection_rule='unbounded_real_only_global_l2_3x3_anchor', uses_context_pooling=false, uses_context_slot_reservation=false, uses_local_candidate_cap=false, local_candidate_cap=null, context_group_count=0, source_types_all_real=true; the integration asserts source_type is all SOURCE_REAL and the emission is exactly K=96 or the G<=K identity bypass. The summariser re-checks all of this and fails closed on any violation.

arms.dense: frozen custom dense (unpruned) path; REFERENCE ONLY, never decision-driving
arms.representative_layer5_l2: frozen layer-5 raw-representative arm (context ablation artifact) at K=96
arms.unbounded_layer5_l2: layer-5 unbounded real-only global-L2 + 3x3 anchor arm at K=96

primary_metric.definition: Official CV-Bench combined score returned by the frozen scorer evaluation.build_cv_bench_pruning_report.score: ((accuracy_ADE20K + accuracy_COCO)/2 + accuracy_Omni3D)/2.
primary_metric.rule: This is the ONE and ONLY primary metric for every arm (dense, representative, unbounded) and for every paired bootstrap comparison. It is never replaced by any other accuracy.

unweighted_metric.definition: Plain unweighted mean over the 100 screening samples.
unweighted_metric.rule: Secondary diagnostic only. It must never be called the CV-Bench primary score and must never drive the decision rule.

dense.subset_rule: restricted to the 100 sample_id values of datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl, preserving manifest order
dense.role: REFERENCE ONLY: unpruned custom-dense reference; it never drives the decision

representative_layer5_l2.role: frozen layer-5 raw-representative arm (context ablation artifact), K=96, screening100

unbounded_layer5_l2.role: layer-5 unbounded real-only global-L2 + 3x3 anchor arm, K=96, screening100
unbounded_layer5_l2.generation_command: python evaluation/run_hf_hardware_regular_layer5_unbounded_l2.py --model <frozen BF16 RoboBrain2.5-4B> --model-label <label> --manifest datasets/cv_bench_screening100.jsonl --output artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-layer5-unbounded-real-only/layer5_unbounded_real_only_k96_screening100.jsonl --score-mode l2 --prune-after-layer 5 --budget 96 --region-grid 3 --dtype bf16 --device cuda:0

validation_requirements.sample_id_identity: The screening manifest, the dense full2638 subset, the representative arm and the unbounded arm must all select exactly the same 100 sample_id values.
validation_requirements.no_duplicates: Each of the four inputs must contain no duplicate sample_id.
validation_requirements.score_mode_l2: Every representative and every unbounded record must have score_mode == "l2".
validation_requirements.budget_k96: Every representative and every unbounded record must have requested_budget == 96; every non-bypass record must emit exactly K=96 output groups.
validation_requirements.cutpoint_5: Every representative and every unbounded record must carry prune_after_layer == 5.
validation_requirements.input_grid_consistency: For every sample_id, the unbounded record's (image_grid_thw, full_patch_tokens, full_llm_visual_tokens) must equal the representative record's tuple.
validation_requirements.representative_declaration: Every representative record must declare context_group_values_source == "representative_raw_group" and uses_pooled_context_group_values == false.
validation_requirements.unbounded_declaration: Every unbounded record must declare selection_rule == "unbounded_real_only_global_l2_3x3_anchor", uses_context_pooling == false, uses_context_slot_reservation == false, uses_local_candidate_cap == false and local_candidate_cap null; source_type must be all 0 (SOURCE_REAL), context_group_count must be 0 and real_group_count must equal output_group_count. A non-bypass record must emit exactly K=96; a bypass record is the G<=K identity bypass.
validation_requirements.selection_metadata_identity: NOT required between the two arms: the single changed variable is the selection constraint/indexing, so selected_group_indices/source_type/region_id legitimately differ. The summariser must never require cross-arm metadata identity.
validation_requirements.input_sha256: Every non-null inputs_sha256 pin in this file is re-verified before scoring.
validation_requirements.fail_closed: If any required input file is missing, or any of the checks above fails, the summariser must raise and must NOT write a report.

decision_rule.uses: 95% CI of score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] for unbounded_minus_representative only
decision_rule.dense_role: reference only; never drives the decision

ordered_rules.meaning: 硬件选择约束有害已确认：去掉 context pooling / context slot reservation / local_candidate_cap、改用无界全局 L2 + 3x3 anchor 后，官方 CV-Bench 主分提升超过 0.02。
硬件选择约束有害未确认：证据不足以证明去掉这些选择约束能带来超过 0.02 的提升。

explicit_non_formal_statement: This diagnostic runs on a fixed stratified 100-sample screening set. Its result is a single-variable selection-constraint attribution signal only and is NOT a formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion; it must not be quoted as the official CV-Bench accuracy of any approach, and it does not authorise promotion, RTL work or hardware claims.
limitations: Screening100 is a diagnostic subset, not the formal 2638-sample CV-Bench benchmark.
The Selector path is software only; no FPGA/board result and no latency/acceleration claim is made.
Both Selector arms are raw real groups at the same cut point and K=96; they differ only in the selection constraint and indexing, so cross-arm selection metadata is not required to match.
Only score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] drives the decision; unweighted_sample_accuracy is descriptive.
Neither arm uses the B1-trained Wv projection.
Validation was already used in development; internal test remains sealed.
